steps.code:
# Get all liked songs (paginate)
liked_songs = []
page = 0
while True:
    result = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not result:
        break
    liked_songs.extend(result)
    if len(result) < 20:
        break
    page += 1
liked_ids = {song['song_id'] for song in liked_songs}
print("Liked song IDs:", liked_ids)
print("Total liked songs:", len(liked_ids))

steps.code:
# Loop to find next liked song
current_song_id = current['song_id']
found = False
max_iterations = 100
for i in range(max_iterations):
    if current_song_id in liked_ids:
        found = True
        break
    # go to next song
    next_result = apis.spotify.next_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("Next song result:", next_result)
    # get current song after moving
    current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    current_song_id = current['song_id']
    print("Current song:", current['title'], "ID:", current_song_id)
    if current_song_id in liked_ids:
        found = True
        break

if found:
    print("Found liked song:", current['title'], "ID:", current_song_id)
    apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=current['title'])
else:
    print("No liked song found in queue")
    apis.supervisor.complete_task(status="fail")
